"""One-off native inventory visual check of the actual crafted-pellet save."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'roguelike'),str(ROOT/'tools'),str(ROOT/'tools/critical_fix_regressions/tests')]
os.environ.update(SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy',SDL_AUDIODRIVER='dummy',PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT='1')
import config
config.DEBUG_MODE=False
import pygame
from g12_journey import run_stage


def actions(e,key,capture,choose,ev,out):
    start=e.world_time.turn
    wood=e.player.inventory.get_by_id('wood_bundle')
    yield key(pygame.K_i,'i')
    yield from choose(e,wood)
    assert e.player.inventory.reductions_for()['Components']==.35
    capture('g12-effective-inventory')
    ev.record.update(controls='Separate visual diagnostic of the actual completed preparation checkpoint. Original Engine.run and native inventory events; no item grants, equipment assignment, movement, actor/needs pause or world turns.',
        raw_item_weight=wood.weight,effective_item_weight=wood.weight*.65,
        raw_load=sum(i.weight for i in e.player.inventory.items),effective_load=e.player.inventory.current_weight)
    yield key(pygame.K_i,'i')
    assert e.world_time.turn==start
    ev.record['world_turns_spent']=0


def main():
    base=ROOT/'evidence/gameplay-g12/final-b/journey'
    out=base/'visual-diagnostics';out.mkdir()
    result=run_stage(out,'inventory',actions,base/'integration/retreat-base.zip')
    source=json.loads((ROOT/'evidence/gameplay-g12/final-b/release.json').read_text())['source']
    assert all(source['roguelike/'+r['relative']]==r['sha256'] for r in result['imported_sources'].values())
    record=dict(passed=True,head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
        command=[sys.executable,'-X','utf8',str(Path(__file__).resolve())],
        probe_source=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),probe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        imported_sources_match_final_inputs=True,raw_item=result['raw_item_weight'],effective_item=result['effective_item_weight'],
        world_turns_spent=0,result='final-b/journey/visual-diagnostics/inventory/result.json')
    (ROOT/'evidence/gameplay-g12/inventory-view.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True,raw_item=record['raw_item'],effective_item=record['effective_item'])))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
